```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (
    is.logical(x)
  ) {
    return(
      replace(
        x,
        is.na(x),
        FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    is.numeric(x)
  ) {
    return(
      !is.na(x) &
        x != 0
    )
  }

  tolower(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  ) %in%
    c(
      "true",
      "t",
      "1",
      "yes",
      "y"
    )
}


check_file <- function(
    file,
    description
) {
  if (
    !file.exists(file)
  ) {
    stop(
      description,
      " not found:\n",
      file
    )
  }
}


read_stability_table <- function(
    file,
    dataset_name
) {
  check_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table"
    )
  )

  tab <- read.csv(
    file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c(
    "Contrast",
    "Gene",
    params$
      stability_flag_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(
      tab
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      missing_columns
    ) > 0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table is missing columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  tab %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Contrast =
        as.character(
          Contrast
        ),

      Gene =
        as.character(
          Gene
        ),

      bootstrap_stable =
        as_flag(
          .data[[
            params$
              stability_flag_column
          ]]
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      Contrast,
      Gene,
      .keep_all =
        TRUE
    )
}


read_primary_de <- function(
    de_dir,
    stability_table,
    dataset_name,
    source_contrast,
    display_contrast,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  de_file <- file.path(
    de_dir,
    paste0(
      source_contrast,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  check_file(
    de_file,
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      " DE file for ",
      source_contrast
    )
  )

  df <- read.csv(
    de_file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(
      "Gene"
    ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required_de_columns <- c(
    "Gene",
    "logFC",
    "FDR"
  )

  missing_de_columns <- setdiff(
    required_de_columns,
    names(
      df
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      missing_de_columns
    ) > 0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " DE file ",
      basename(
        de_file
      ),
      " is missing columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_de_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    flip_logfc
  ) {
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        logFC =
          -as.numeric(
            logFC
          )
      )
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        logFC =
          as.numeric(
            logFC
          )
      )
  }

  stability_for_contrast <- stability_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast ==
        source_contrast
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Gene,
      bootstrap_stable
    )

  n_stability_rows <- nrow(
    stability_for_contrast
  )

  if (
    n_stability_rows ==
      0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": no stability records found for contrast ",
      source_contrast,
      "."
    )
  }

  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Gene =
        as.character(
          Gene
        ),

      FDR =
        as.numeric(
          FDR
        )
    ) %>%

    dplyr::left_join(
      stability_for_contrast,
      by =
        "Gene"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(
      
      fdr_significant =
        !is.na(
          FDR
        ) &
        FDR <=
        params$
          fdr_cutoff,

      
      
      
      bootstrap_stable =
        dplyr::coalesce(
          bootstrap_stable,
          FALSE
        ),

      stable_significant =
        fdr_significant &
        bootstrap_stable,

      status =
        dplyr::case_when(
          stable_significant &
            logFC >
            0 ~
              "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

          stable_significant &
            logFC <
            0 ~
              "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

          fdr_significant &
            !bootstrap_stable ~
              "FDR significant, not bootstrap-stable",

          TRUE ~
              "Not significant"
        ),

      status =
        factor(
          status,
          levels =
            status_levels
        ),

      neglog10FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            FDR,
            1e-300
          )
        ),

      dataset =
        dataset_name,

      source_contrast =
        source_contrast,

      contrast =
        display_contrast
    )
}
```

```{r}
plot_volcano_stability <- function(
    df,
    title,
    output_stub,
    label_n = params$label_n
) {
  label_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      stable_significant
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      FDR,
      dplyr::desc(
        abs(
          logFC
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n =
        label_n
    )

  
  
  nonsig_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      status ==
        "Not significant"
    )

  unstable_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      status ==
        "FDR significant, not bootstrap-stable"
    )

  stable_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      stable_significant
    )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x =
        logFC,
      y =
        neglog10FDR
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data =
        nonsig_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        color =
          status
      ),
      alpha =
        0.55,
      size =
        1.35
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data =
        unstable_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        color =
          status
      ),
      alpha =
        0.75,
      size =
        1.45
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data =
        stable_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        color =
          status
      ),
      alpha =
        0.85,
      size =
        1.55
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept =
        -log10(
          params$
            fdr_cutoff
        ),
      linetype =
        "dashed",
      linewidth =
        0.35,
      color =
        "black"
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data =
        label_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        label =
          Gene
      ),
      size =
        3,
      max.overlaps =
        Inf,
      box.padding =
        0.35,
      point.padding =
        0.20,
      min.segment.length =
        0,
      seed =
        20260810
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values =
        status_colors,
      breaks =
        status_levels,
      limits =
        status_levels,
      drop =
        FALSE,
      name =
        NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        title,
      x =
        expression(
          log[2] *
            " fold-change"
        ),
      y =
        expression(
          -log[10](
            "FDR"
          )
        )
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size =
        13
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face =
            "bold",
          hjust =
            0.5
        ),

      legend.position =
        "top",

      legend.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            9
        )
    )

  svg_file <- file.path(
    plot_dir,
    paste0(
      output_stub,
      ".svg"
    )
  )

  pdf_file <- file.path(
    plot_dir,
    paste0(
      output_stub,
      ".pdf"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      svg_file,
    plot =
      p,
    width =
      7.2,
    height =
      5.6,
    device =
      "svg"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      pdf_file,
    plot =
      p,
    width =
      7.2,
    height =
      5.6,
    device =
      grDevices::
        cairo_pdf
  )

  p
}
```
